subject: Unify hook enforcement policy across Node shell wrappers
description: Extract shared hook enforcement policy so Node and shell hook entrypoints enforce the same rules. Shell hooks should delegate to the canonical Node implementation instead of duplicating policy. Adapter wrappers should remain payload-normalization/delegation only. Update focused parity tests for Bash and Write/Edit/apply_patch behavior.

summary: Unified hook gate enforcement by extracting shared policy into hooks/lib/gate-policy.js, making Node Write/Edit and Bash gates call it, and replacing POSIX shell gates with thin delegates to the canonical Node hooks. Updated hook tests to use a child-process HTTP daemon stub rather than curl stubs, and tightened Bash claimed-worktree confinement to require every non-exempt extracted target inside a claimed worktree. Verified syntax checks, node test/orch-gate.test.js (20/20), node test/orch-gate-bash.test.js (45/45), node test/apply-patch-confinement.test.js (18/18), and node test/hooks-e2e.js (31/31).
